set.body: Roadmap: bd-01KWWWGMETE2R216KQZWVAJKYV. Scope: modules/mvpa-spatial. Acceptance: wrap FeatureSetPlan with a SpatialFeatureDomain so volume/surface/atlas/searchlight feature axes are not erased; add SearchlightWindowSet and SearchlightCenter/LinearVoxelIndex; make atlas parcel coverage policy explicit; preserve stable surface parcel metadata and make ordinal vs key identity policy explicit; replace catch-all stringly adapter errors with SpatialPlanError cases plus compatibility conversion to MvpaError. Verification: mvpaSpatialJVM/test and mvpaSpatialJS/test plus mvpa/image/surface/atlas compile fallout.
set.title: Type spatial MVPA feature domains, searchlights, parcels, and adapter errors
